                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "W$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 70,
                                  "text": "- **Input-to-output ratios** — when input tokens dwarf output tokens, the user is paying to re-send a bloated context every turn. Strongest signal that compaction, smaller working sets, or fresh sessions would help.\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {

                              },
                              "references": []
                            },

                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "W$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 69,
                                  "text": "- **Model mix** — break down spend by `usage_model`. Are premium models being used for routine work (renames, simple edits, status checks) that a cheaper model could handle?\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 69
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "W$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 68,
                                  "text": "- **Per-turn growth** — within long sessions, does `usage_input_tokens` keep climbing turn-over-turn? Strong signal that compaction wasn't used.\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 68
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "W$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 67,
                                  "text": "- **Oversized pastes** — `LENGTH(user_content)` on `events` where `type = 'user.message'` to find user messages that should have been file references (also visible in `session_files` as repeated reads of the same path within one session).\n",

                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 63,
                                  "text": "- **Long sessions without compaction** — sessions with many turns and no rows in `checkpoints` (each `checkpoints` row is a successful compaction). `LEFT JOIN checkpoints c ON c.session_id = s.id WHERE c.session_id IS NULL` + a turn-count threshold gives prime candidates.\n",

                              "ctor": 2,

                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 62,
                                  "text": "- **Late compaction** — for sessions that *do* have checkpoints, compare `checkpoints.checkpoint_number` and `created_at` against the session's turn count. A first compaction at turn 60 of an 80-turn session is far less helpful than one at turn 25.\n",

                              "ctor": 2,

                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 61,
                                  "text": "- **Repeated large file reads** — in `session_files`, look for the same file read many times within one session, or across sessions.\n",

                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 111,
                                  "text": "Schema essentials (full schema is in the **Database Schema** section below — re-read it before writing the query):\n",

                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "W$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 109,
                                  "text": "- The `sessions` table primary key is `id` (NOT `session_id`). Every other table uses `session_id` as the FK back to `sessions.id`. Always project `s.id` from `sessions`.\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }

                              "props": {
                                "priority": 109
                              },

                            },

                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "W$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 108,
                                  "text": "- Don't invent names: there is no `started_at` (use `created_at`/`updated_at`), no `workspace` (use `cwd` locally; cloud has none), no `title` (use `summary`), no `content`/`messages` (use `turns.user_message`/`turns.assistant_response`, or on cloud `events.user_content`/`events.assistant_content`).\n",

                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 108
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "W$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 107,
                                  "text": "- **Local SQLite**: prefer the FTS5 `search_index` table (`WHERE search_index MATCH '<query>'`) for body content — `search_index` already has a `session_id` column, so select it directly (`SELECT session_id, content FROM search_index WHERE search_index MATCH ...`). Do **not** join `search_index.rowid` to `turns.rowid`; they are unrelated and you will pull in unrelated sessions. File paths and refs aren't in the FTS index — combine with `LIKE` on `session_files.file_path` and `session_refs.ref_value`.\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 107
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },

                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "W$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 106,

                                  "lineBreakBefore": true

Then enrich from `sessions` using `WHERE id IN (...)`. This avoids the expensive JOIN on a large scan result that causes timeouts.\n",
